positions.title: Graduate Student Research Assistant
positions.description:
Vehicle Dynamics, Estimation and Control:

Developed physics based models and simulations of off-road vehicles encompassing multi-body dynamics, power-train components, and the terrain-vehicle interaction to serve as a testing platform for autonomous vehicle control.

Programmed and built hardware to time synchronize vehicle CAN data with external ultrasonic ride height, IMU, GPS, and load pin sensor measurements. This was used to collect Antarctic experimental data for model validation.

Developed a manned leader, autonomous follower control architecture for robotic assisted Antarctic traverses.

Developed a Kalman Filter for state-force estimation used with Bayesian inference for real-time terrain characterization.

Designed a gain scheduled, PID traction control system for maintaining vehicle mobility in soft terrain conditions.
positions.insights: Skills: Vehicle Dynamics · State Estimation · Terramechanics · Modeling and Simulation

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I was an engineering intern for MRAP (Mine Resistant Ambush Protection) Vehicle Reverse Engineering Project. My responsibility was to research performance requirements of parts associated with level 3 technical drawings.

educations.schoolName: Thayer School of Engineering at Dartmouth

educations.fieldOfStudy: Civil Engineering B.S. / Electrical Engineering Minor

projects.title: Autonomous Navigation Robot
projects.description: My team and I developed a robot capable of navigating through a cluttered environment to a goal autonomously. Mechanical design included motor and wheel size selections based on payload requirements. Infrared position sensors and optical encoders were deployed for state estimation. These components were interfaced with a microprocessor which generated motion plans for the robot using an artificial potential field algorithm.

projects.title: Power Electronics for River Turbines (Dartmouth Humanitarian Engineering)
projects.description: My team and I designed an electrical power system for energy gathering and storage from river turbines. Prototypes of the power converters and switching circuits for control were developed and tested for proof of concept.

publications.title: Mobility Enhancement of Heavy-Duty Tracked Vehicles Under Load Using Real-Time Terrain Characterization, Traction Control, and a Towing Winch
publications.publisher: ASME, Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement and Control · Jan 1, 2019

publications.title: Ph.D. Thesis: Dynamics modeling and control of autonomous tractors for polar traverses
